falsified_assumption: Fencing the digest of a caller-supplied RetrievalPlan is sufficient provenance hardening when derived RetrievalResult score fields can already be internally inconsistent before the fence is created.
mechanism: FamiliarityPredictionBinding.create records retrieval_plan.sha256() from the supplied plan but does not independently validate that the plan was produced by the deterministic WP301 derivation.

G2 evaluate validates weighted_score_bp bounds, overlap_count length, and rank_score == weighted_score_bp * overlap_count, but does not reconstruct weighted_score_bp from signal_scores_bp and RetrievalNeed.axis_weights_bp.
It also does not reconstruct bottleneck_score_bp or overlap_axes from signal_scores_bp, so a self-consistent digest can preserve a pre-fencing derived-score forgery.
The review test leaves the original signal_scores_bp at 1000, inflates only weighted_score_bp/rank_score to 10000 before binding construction, and observes accepted familiarity_bp 10000.
recommended_smallest_repair: During retrieval provenance validation, validate signal_scores_bp axes, uniqueness and basis-point bounds against the supplied RetrievalNeed axes.
Recompute overlap_axes/overlap_count from positive signal scores.
Recompute weighted_score_bp from signal_scores_bp and RetrievalNeed.axis_weights_bp and require exact equality.
Recompute bottleneck_score_bp and rank_score and require exact equality.
Preserve the existing exact plan digest/need digest fences; do not weaken them.

If true builder-origin provenance is required beyond internal derivation consistency, bind an independently supplied upstream WP301 plan receipt/digest rather than deriving both expected and observed identity from the same caller-supplied object.
next_exact_action: The sole WP302 G2 claimant should incorporate this counterexample into its existing provenance-hardening lane, add deterministic derived-score reconstruction/fail-closed checks, and rerun canonical plus adversarial repository CI before any G2 acceptance.
